primaryEvidence.name: Government commissioned infiltration-method evidence review
primaryEvidence.role: Divide-by20 is a coarse heating-season method, not site or instantaneous infiltration. Actual wind, stack, shelter and leakage distribution remain necessary; no universal weather divisor used here.
